answer: Every fresh identity needs two established vouchers, each escrowing 300 POA for six epochs, and must pass one lantern audit of a random graded task before its seal counts. A meadow of one hundred clone keys shares the same voucher chain, so one failed audit slashes every bond in that chain jointly, depth by depth. The garden caps each voucher at five spawns and one vote. The tenth clone pays ten deposits and burns all five vouchers at once, while honest keys keep full weight.
